# Renuity

> Renuity is a home remodeling and renovation company specializing in bathroom remodeling, window replacement, and flooring services with a focus on accessibility, energy efficiency, and quality installations.

Renuity offers comprehensive home improvement solutions including bathroom renovations with premium brands like KOHLER, window replacement in multiple styles, and free no-obligation estimates. The company emphasizes accessible bathing solutions, energy-efficient products, and professional installation services across residential properties.
